Title: Omnicell Medication Dispensing Cabinets - Loopback Update

As a result, the subject requirement shall be pursued via direct-award to Trillamed, LLC IAW RFO 19.106-3 "Sole Source Awards", utilizing the GSA eBuy Federal Supply Schedule contract 36F79720D0041 under Special Item Number 65 II A-92 "Medication and Supply Packaging and Dispensing Equipment". A Justification for Other than Full and Open Competition has been approved, and a redacted version shall be posted with the official award synopsis. Title: Residential Furniture Leasing Services
Description: A. GENERAL A.1. The Contractor shall provide residential furniture leasing services for the U.S. Embassy in Canberra, the U.S. Consulate General in Sydney, and the U.S. Consulate General in Melbourne, Australia, in accordance with the Statement of Work (SOW) and all attachments incorporated into this contract. The prices set forth herein shall be firm-fixed and shall include all costs associated with performance under this contract, including, but not limited to, labor, materials, transportation, insurance, overhead, and profit. No additional compensation shall be authorized unless otherwise specified in writing by the Contracting Officer. The Government shall pay the Contractor a firm-fixed price for services that are performed in a satisfactory manner and in full compliance with the terms and conditions of this contract. A.2. This is a firm fixed-price Indefinite Delivery Indefinity Quantity type of contract payable entirely in Australian dollars, as indicated in Sub-Section C. Pricing. No additional sums will be payable on account of any escalation in the cost of materials, equipment or labor, or because of the Contractor's failure to properly estimate or accurately predict the cost or difficulty of achieving the results required by this contract, nor will the contract price be adjusted on account of fluctuations in the currency exchange rates. Changes in the contract price or time to complete will be made only due to changes made by the Government in the work to be performed, or by delays caused by the Government (see FAR 52.212.4(f), Excusable Delays), as determined and approved by the Contracting Officer. B. PERFORMANCE WORK STATEMENT B.1. The Contractor shall provide residential furniture leasing services for the U.S. Embassy in Canberra, the U.S. Consulate General in Sydney, and the U.S. Consulate General in Melbourne, Australia, in accordance with the Statement of Work (SOW) and all attachments incorporated into this contract. B.2. The period of performance of this contract is for one base year with two (2) one-year options.

Title: NOAA Ship Okeanos Explorer Contaminated Fuel remov
Description: REQUISITION This is a Combined Synopsis/Solicitation for Commercial Items prepared in accordance with the format in FAR SUBPART 12.6, as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; quotes are being requested and a written solicitation will not be issued. This Combined Synopsis/Solicitation 1333MK26Q0071 constitutes a Request for Quotation (RFQ) which Incorporates provisions and clauses in effect through the Federal Acquisition Circular 2026-01. The National Oceanic Atmospheric Administration (NOAA), Office of Marine & Aviation Operations (OMAO), Marine Operation Center (MOC), NOAA Ship Okeanos Explorer requires 16,000 gallons of contaminated fuel removed from the vessels tanks. The solicitation is being issued as a total small business set-aside. The associated NAICS code is 562211 with a size standard of $47.0 Million. The SCA is exempted under Section 4(b) d. Maintenance, calibration, repair, and/or installation (not subject to the DBA, as provided in 29 CFR 4.116(c)(2) for all types of equipment where the services are obtained from the manufacturer or supplier under a contract awarded on a sole source basis) (see 29 CFR 4.123(e)(2)(i)(D). Quotes will be evaluated in accordance with FAR 52.212-2 Evaluation-Commercial Products and Commercial Services (Nov 2021). Responses are due by 07:00am EST/EDT on May 27 2026. There will be no exceptions to the time and date on which responses are due, unless determined otherwise by the Government. Your response, technical, and pricing should be forwarded electronically to the Contracting Specialist via email no later than the date and time specified above. When responding, please include the Requisition number in the subject line. To verify receipt of your response, please contact me either by email or phone. Christopher Baker Christopher.Baker@noaa.gov FIRM FIXED PRICE CLIN 0001 – BASE PoP Services, non-personal, to provide all labor, equipment and materials (unless otherwise provided herein) necessary for Provide the services for an emergency pump-off of approx. 16,000 Gallons of Diesel Fuel mixed with ~8% seawater from NOAA Ship Okeanos Explorer. REQUIRMENT: • Pump-off of approx. 16,000 Gallons of Diesel Fuel mixed with ~8% seawater from NOAA Ship Okeanos Explorer. Removal and disposal must be in accordance with all local, state and federal regulations. • Connection is through 4.0” camlock fitting. SCOPE OF WORK The Contractor shall provide all labor, supervision, equipment, materials, transportation, containment, and incidentals necessary to perform an emergency fuel pump-out operation from the NOAA vessel. Services shall include, but are not limited to: • Mobilization of qualified personnel and equipment to the vessel location within the required response timeframe. • Provision of pumps, hoses, fittings, containment systems, spill response equipment, and vacuum or tanker trucks as required. • Safe transfer of approximately 16,000 gallons of marine diesel fuel from the vessel’s fuel tanks. • Transportation of recovered fuel to an approved facility. • Compliance with all applicable federal, state, local, and environmental regulations. • Spill prevention and immediate spill response assistance during all transfer operations. • Coordination with NOAA representatives, port authorities, and applicable regulatory agencies. • Documentation of quantities removed, chain of custody, disposal manifests (if applicable), and operational reports. DELIVERABLE SCHEDULE: Between May 28 and May 31, 2026 DELIVERY ADDRESS: NOAA Ship Okeanos Explorer 1897 Ranger Loop - BLDG. 184 Honolulu, HI., 96818 UTILIZATION OF FEDCONNECT® FOR CONTRACT ADMINISTRATION The Department of Commerce will utilize the FedConnect® web portal in administering this award. Title: Saipan Dumpsters and Disposal Services
Description: The government requires Municipal Solid Waste (MSW) refuse collection and disposal services to support military exercise operations at the Cowtown in Saipan CNMI (Commonwealth of the Northern Marianas Islands) from June 1st through July 16th. The contractor must provide a minimum total container capacity of 40 cubic yards at Cowtown with the flexibility to utilize any combination of commercial dumpster sizes to meet these volumetric requirements. This is a performance-based service requiring a minimum of weekly collection; however, the contractor must dynamically adjust the service frequency to ensure no container ever exceeds 80% of its capacity at any time. The contractor is responsible for all hauling and lawful off-site disposal in accordance with local CNMI regulations, ensuring zero spillage during operations. This requirement is being solicited as a 100% Small Business Set-Aside.Payment will be processed via Government Purchase Card (GPC) or Wide Area Workflow (WAWF). All transaction fees or administrative costs associated with these payment methods shall be included in the quoted price. PLEASE REFERENCE THE ATTACHED SOLICITATION AND PERFORMANCE WORK STATEMENT FOR FULL DETAILS and SCOPE.

Title: Transportation of a barge, vessel and boat for DR4910-MP
Description: *********THE RESPONSE TIME HAS BEEN EXTENDED FROM 4P TO 6P******** DUE TO THE URGENT NEED THIS HAS A QUICK RESPONSE TIME OF 24 HOURS The Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) Procurement Section is issuing this urgent Request for Quotation (RFQ) for the purpose of procuring the rental of the transportation of a barge, vessel, and boat within the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands for disaster declaration 4910-MP. This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial products or commercial services prepared in accordance with part 12, and part 15. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. Offers are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. The solicitation number 70FBR926Q00000010 is issued as a request for quotes (RFQ) for the rental of the transportation of a barge, vessel, and boat to and from the island of Managaha / Saipan in support the operations within DR4910-MP. This acquisition is a set-aside for small business concerns. This solicitation incorporates provisions and clauses by reference. The full text of provisions and clauses may be accessed electronically at www.acquisition.gov. The contract period of performance is 6 days from the date of award. The quotation shall be submitted to the Contracting Officer, Demetria Carter at demetria.carter@fema.dhs.gov and cc: kimberly.sanders@fema.dhs.gov no later than 4:00 pm PAS, May 25, 2026.

Title: Saipan Shower Rentals and Services
Description: The Government requires turn-key, self-contained portable shower services to support military exercise operations at the Cowtown site in Saipan from June 7th through July 12th. The contractor shall provide a minimum of 10 shower stalls for males and 3 separate stalls for females. As the site lacks existing infrastructure, the provided units must be entirely self-sufficient; the contractor is responsible for providing all necessary power generation, fuel, and a daily supply of at least 1,000 gallons of non-potable water. Furthermore, the contractor must ensure the 100% containment and lawful off-site disposal of all grey water. This includes performing daily cleaning and maintenance to guarantee that grey water tanks never exceed 75% capacity at any given time. This requirement is being solicited as a 100% Small Business Set-Aside.Payment will be processed via Government Purchase Card (GPC) or Wide Area Workflow (WAWF). All transaction fees or administrative costs associated with these payment methods shall be included in the quoted price. PLEASE REFERENCE THE ATTACHED SOLICITATION AND PERFORMANCE WORK STATEMENT FOR FULL DETAILS and SCOPE.
